notes: All scoped parent references use composite (workspace_id,id) foreign keys. Only auth.users is a permitted foreign-key target outside cs_*.
VersionRef and AssetRef follow the sibling Creative Studio contracts packet; UUID and sha256 are not interchangeable.
Role/DDL creation belongs to CS-M2. No SQL in this artifact has been executed or tested.
Every table below carries created_at; immutable rows also carry created_by/runtime_principal_id and payload schema_version where relevant.
All public cs_* tables enable and force RLS; runtime roles never own tables or have BYPASSRLS.
No default grants are relied on; revoke PUBLIC, anon, authenticated domain-table grants.
The initial budget ceiling is zero. No media allowance is inferred from BCI or research budgets.

JSON/array-held local VersionRef and AssetRef values require insert-time same-workspace existence/revision/digest validation via a fixed kind-to-CS-table map; UUID arrays are not unverified foreign keys.

Every execution work item has exactly one durable owner: run/node or pre-run operation/step. Compile, Brand CI import and AI treatment authoring never require a fabricated recipe, execution plan or run.

Paid operations share the exact reservation/attempt/receipt/ledger contracts, with operation_id XOR run_id. Input/output version rows remain immutable and may be referenced by later independent operations/runs.
A SECURITY INVOKER insert validator enforces owner consistency between attempts, receipts, reservations and ledger; cost rows cannot reassign an operation charge to a run.

cs_api.scope: actor/action/workspace RLS; no unrelated schemas; no ledger settlement

cs_worker.scope: CS worker state + artifacts/receipts/ledger only; no membership/budget-policy mutations

authenticated.storage: exact upload intent/download grant or scoped CS machine principal

procedure_contracts.name: cs_claim_work
procedure_contracts.output: work item plus exactly-one verified run/node or operation/step scope and internal lease

procedure_contracts.name: cs_heartbeat_work
procedure_contracts.precondition: token+fence match; state leased; lease unexpired; stage deadline not exceeded
procedure_contracts.effect: record heartbeat_at; hard lease stays claim_time+360 seconds; never revive expired lease

procedure_contracts.name: cs_finish_work
atomic: allocate owner event sequence under run OR operation row lock
schedule next ready work under same owner
complete operation only after all exact immutable results persist

procedure_contracts.name: cs_prepare_attempt
atomic: validate same-owner reserved budget/authorization for run OR treatment_authoring operation
insert immutable admission/event before network call
procedure_contracts.output: attempt ID and provider idempotency key

procedure_contracts.name: cs_mark_dispatching
procedure_contracts.precondition: valid leased provider_submit and prepared attempt
procedure_contracts.effect: append dispatching event before network call

procedure_contracts.name: cs_settle_cost
procedure_contracts.precondition: documented charge/no-charge evidence for same provider attempt
atomic: lock account/reservation and require same run OR operation owner

procedure_contracts.name: cs_create_download_grant
procedure_contracts.precondition: current read authority and stored immutable version

procedure_contracts.name: cs_storage_allowed
procedure_contracts.security: narrow SECURITY DEFINER in unexposed cs_private, fixed search_path, auth.uid check, explicit grants
procedure_contracts.effect: boolean exact intent/grant or scoped machine-principal match

procedure_contracts.name: cs_dispatch_due
procedure_contracts.effect: bounded due items to exact trusted worker URL using unique Vault worker secret; respects runtime flags

procedure_contracts.name: cs_reconcile_due
procedure_contracts.effect: recover wakeups/stale local leases; route ambiguous paid dispatches to reconciliation, never blind resubmit

procedure_contracts.name: cs_save_authoring_draft
procedure_contracts.precondition: current workspace producer action and matching expected_revision
procedure_contracts.effect: save non-executable partial form/graph with incremented revision/hash

procedure_contracts.name: cs_promote_authoring_draft
procedure_contracts.precondition: all source/version refs valid; complete recipe contract; optimistic revision match
procedure_contracts.effect: immutable source/treatment/recipe versions; compile remains separate

procedure_contracts.name: cs_admit_compile
procedure_contracts.precondition: exact immutable cs-recipe-v1 VersionRef, no draft or partial payload
procedure_contracts.effect: atomically insert cs_operations(kind=compile), operation event, idempotency receipt and operation-owned compile work item; return202+Location; no plan or run created yet, no provider budget

procedure_contracts.name: cs_admit_brand_import
procedure_contracts.precondition: current workspace producer/import authority, exact approved BCI package reference and request hash
procedure_contracts.effect: return202 operation; verify package/files/hash/rights through authenticated BCI API and attach immutable source-import result only after persistence; no fake run

procedure_contracts.name: cs_admit_treatment_authoring
procedure_contracts.precondition: explicit paid user action, valid creative request/policy refs, intended workspace text-model credential and approved nonzero budget
procedure_contracts.effect: return202 operation; never create accepted treatment, recipe, plan or run

procedure_contracts.name: cs_finish_operation
procedure_contracts.precondition: valid fenced operation-owned work; all declared result artifacts durable and contract-valid
procedure_contracts.effect: compile yields execution plan; import yields source/brand package ref; authoring yields draft treatment ref

procedure_contracts.name: cs_get_operation
procedure_contracts.effect: scoped cs-operation-v1 projection with derived attempts/receipt_ids and ordered events, admission/cost/results; completed result refs immutable; no lease or secret payload

procedure_contracts.name: cs_request_cancel_operation
procedure_contracts.precondition: current workspace producer authority and matching expected_event_sequence
procedure_contracts.effect: append operation cancel request, prevent new paid dispatch, retain accepted provider reconciliation and unresolved holds

procedure_contracts.name: cs_reconcile_operation
procedure_contracts.precondition: current authorized support/producer action, matching expected_event_sequence, exact provider receipt or bounded supported replay evidence
procedure_contracts.effect: schedule operation-owned reconciliation; does not create a new paid intent or release unknown cost without evidence

sql_generation_requirements: CREATE ROLE runtime roles without superuser/createrole/createdb/bypassrls; verify grants do not inherit unrelated roles
explicitly grant table/procedure privileges and enable/force RLS
scope every asset/version/run/attempt foreign key by workspace
immutable table mutation rejection and ledger uniqueness
no unscoped security-definer functions or PUBLIC execute
no migration execution or testing during CS-M1
